Bug_Title: Case insensitive Unicode regular expressions should enable the "UNICODE_CASE" flag
Bug_Explanation: The bug is present because the regular expressions are intended to be case insensitive but do not handle Unicode characters correctly. By not enabling the UNICODE_CASE flag, the regex does not correctly match Unicode characters in a case-insensitive manner.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test cases intentionally use input with uppercase Unicode characters to showcase that the regular expressions specified in the methods are not handling Unicode characters in a case-insensitive manner due to the absence of the UNICODE_CASE flag. This causes the assertions to fail and trigger the bug.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results indicate that all tests passed successfully, which means the expected behavior was observed. The tests were expected to fail if the bug was triggered, but they did not, thus the presence of the bug is not confirmed by the test results.
